rongmei.title: Kalvari khou jaujian lou mei tei

lines: 1. Kalvari khou jaujian loumei 9!@,
Lik khap kandiu kandih namru khou hei
Nang rui khan pat lou mei guai 9!@,
Thei mei rianrapui ram khou bam.
Chorus:
He poubaumei nang tikgun daimei jaujianrui,
Ndaoh khap diu zat guai na khou ;
Meiguai lungning pap khou man ngam,
Nang jan nthanmei thuanku kandiu.
2. Airui rianra rianriu bam khou hei,
Thou cho poubaumei ata kanlou khang?
Kandih khou hei nang jan din khang,
Nkhalou diu khang mei mak ge.
3. Kandih khou nkhuai mei muangjing kum,
Jing guange poubaumei alung khou hei;
Tigan lou o nang tikgun rui,
Alung mun kumma puang datni.
4. Nangta ninga kapbe poubaumei,
Njianmei guai tingsanga lungpui ram;
Kap bammei hei tabui nung rui,
Neilah mikdui phui dat ni cho?
